q1_issues.issue: The night is only a temporal anchor in an "after" adjunct, which is to get its class atom and the ordering relation and no tense or status of its own; (Past sk_night_1) is exactly the atom that rule forbids.
The distance measure drops its second relatum — (Measure benton_harbor distance (ParticleFromNormal 100 10) mile) asserts an unanchored distance rather than the stated distance from Chicago.

q2_gaps: a measured distance BETWEEN two entities ("about 100 miles northeast of Chicago") — Measure is one-place over an entity and there is no two-place distance form
a possessive on an event-denoting noun ("Jackson's visit") — the genitive rule allows only PartOf or Possession and never licenses the Agent used here
"came after" as a light verb over an event noun — the light-verb list is occurred / happened / took place
notes: The "southwestern Michigan" sub-region witness and the sigma-approximately-10%-of-X hedge on "about 100 miles" both follow the instruction set exactly, and NortheastOf is licensed as a CamelCase-joined multi-word surface preposition. The temporal-anchor rule's "nothing else" wording is stricter than a modified anchor NP allows — the peaceful, Degree and Location atoms on the night are stated content rather than status, so only the tense atom is flagged.
